# awscc_cloudwatch_integration (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::Integration. Manages a CloudWatch (Amazon CloudWatch Observability / Omni) account-scoped integration. V1 supports AWS_CONFIG_SLREC, AWS_INTEGRATION, and EXTERNAL_AGENT.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_type` (String) The type of integration. Immutable after creation.
- `name` (String) The customer-supplied name of the integration. Unique per account.

### Optional

- `credential` (Attributes) Write-only API-key credential material for the integration. Stored encrypted and never returned on read. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential))
- `integration_attributes` (Map of String) Type-specific configuration attributes (max 50 entries). EXTERNAL_AGENT requires 'catalogId'. On update, supplied attributes merge into the existing map; omitting a key does not remove it.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN the integration assumes. Required for AWS_INTEGRATION (a valid, service-assumable IAM role ARN). Not used by AWS_CONFIG_SLREC or EXTERNAL_AGENT.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags associated with the integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time at which the integration was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `integration_arn` (String) The ARN of the integration. arn:aws:cloudwatch:{region}:{account}:integration/{integrationId}.
- `integration_id` (String) The service-generated unique identifier (UUID) of the integration.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) The time at which the integration was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--credential"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credential`

Optional:

- `api_key_credential` (Attributes) API-key credential material that can be rotated in place on update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential--api_key_credential))

<a id="nestedatt--credential--api_key_credential"></a>

Optional:

- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_integration.example
  identity = {
    integration_arn = "integration_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `integration_arn` (String) The ARN of the integration

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_cloudwatch_integration.example
  id = "integration_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_cloudwatch_integration.example "integration_arn"
```
